QUOTE: The part before the first `:` is matched against the tool name. The part after it is matched against the argument value. ... `git.commit` | that tool, any args (no colon means tool name only)
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states fnmatch matching, splitting at the first colon into a tool part and an argument part, and that a pattern with no colon matches on tool name alone.
